title: kotschyella cilicica
intro: Kotschyella cilicica, commonly known as Turkish lavender, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asclepiadaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including relief from anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its calming and soothing effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and terpenoids. These constituents are believed to possess anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, contributing to the plant's potential health benefits.
